Validates documents against a JSON Schema. The result is a list of
errors, each starting with the path to the invalid value, or an empty list
if the document is valid.

A time is validated as a string and inf as a map, because that is how they
are written in JSON. An invalid schema, a pattern that awk cannot match,
and a type that has no JSON equivalent are errors.

A schema can refer to other schema documents. The test passes one of them
and leaves one out, and a reference to the one left out is an error in the
result.
